source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE items 4/5 and abstract: effect of liquid nitrogen storage vs fresh lysis on four AML patients. MaxQuant FreshFrozen_SS summary.txt groups HR82_FRESH with Exp_1A and HR82_FROZEN with Exp_1B (17 -> Exp_2A/B, 23 -> Exp_3A/B, FIL -> Exp_4A/B), so suffix A = fresh, B = frozen, and HR82/17/23/FIL = patients 1-4. Independent data checks on deposited peptides.txt (fresh range-read from Search_FreshFrozen-LF.zip / Search_FreshFrozen_SS.zip; summary.txt byte-identical to cached copy): (a) patient identity: patient-centred log2 peptide profiles (7843 peptides) correlate block-diagonally between LF experiments n-A/n-B and SS light Exp_nA/nB (same-patient r = 0.28-0.74, other-patient r <= 0.19), so LF patient n = SS patient n for all four; Y-chromosome peptides appear only for patient 4 in both sets; (b) A/B orientation: per-patient (A - B) difference vectors correlate positively between LF and SS for all 16 patient pairs (diagonal 0.10-0.20, none negative), so LF -A has the same orientation as SS A (= FRESH). Cleavage: partial (first 20 MB compressed) range-read of each FreshFrozen evidence.txt covering all raw files: every LF, SS-proteome and phospho run shows a single-trypsin pattern (K-terminal 48-65%, R-terminal 34-49%, no Lys-C-eluate signature), consistent with Trypsin only and PRIDE 'FASP single digested'. Phospho runs 91.5-97.4% phosphopeptide evidence, confirming enrichment; PRIDE names IMAC as the enrichment used for the fresh/frozen comparison; Phospho (STY) variable only for these 8 files in summary.txt.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files (168 entries, every projectAccessions == PXD003822): 163 RAW + 5 SEARCH zips. Across the six sibling SDRFs all 163 RAW files are claimed exactly once (no duplicates, no unclaimed, no names absent from PRIDE). 8 SDRF data files = 8 phospho raw files (*_FRESH/*_FROZEN) = PRIDE item 5 '8 raw files from the phosphoenrichment'; each with one SILAC light and one SILAC heavy row.

design_consistency.evidence: 4 patients x fresh/frozen, one run each (fraction 1); biological replicate = patient 1-4, individual FF_patient_n consistent with MaxQuant Exp_nA/B grouping and sibling SDRFs. Heavy spike-in technical replicates 1-8 = one per run.
